sources.quote: Load a Game Pak into the top of the Control Deck as shown.

AC ADAPTER JACK / RF SWITCH JACK / MULTI OUT JACK / Plug the Super NES Controllers into the sockets on the front of the Control / The two (2) Super NES Controllers are identical and can be plugged into
Slide the power switch to the on position. / Push the reset button and / Push the eject button.
before .attempting to load a Game Pak into the Control Deck.

notes: BODY (museum tier): Computer History Museum 102618771, 'Super Nintendo Entertainment System control deck', model SNS-001, 1990. The record prints '7 3/4w x 3h x 9 3/8l (in)' and '19.68w x 7.62h x 23.81l (cm)'; CHM's w/h/l mapped w→width, h→height, l→depth (CHM cataloguing convention); the box is the centimetre line shifted to millimetres. The record's object also lists controller, AC adapter, RF modulator and multi-out cable; the dimension line is read as the control deck's (a set would not fit 7 3/4 x 3 x 9 3/8 in), stated here as a reading, not a record label. Mass '3 (lb)' is whole-pound and not used. excludes_projections null.
Nintendo of Europe's 'Super Nintendo' Technical Details page (PAL SNES, SNSP-001A, a different shell) prints 'Size 200mm x 72mm x 242mm' without axis labels; not filed (and not this model).

media/ports/controls: scan of Nintendo of America's Super NES Control Deck instruction booklet (archive.org item Super_Nintendo_Instruction_Booklet_1991_Nintendo_US, print code HW(B)-SNS-USA-2); quotes are the scan's OCR text layer, cut to clean spans (the OCR reads 'P ush', '.attempting'). 'SUPER NES COMPONENTS' rear view: AC ADAPTER JACK → power_in 1, RF SWITCH JACK → rf_out 1, MULTI OUT JACK → multi_av_out 1; front sockets for 'The two (2) Super NES Controllers' → controller_proprietary 2. The bottom expansion connector does not appear in the booklet and is not filed. CH3-CH4 SWITCH listed, form not printed, not mapped. Controls: 'Slide the power switch' → power_switch; reset button → reset_button; eject button → eject_button.
status 'verified' here means envelope (museum tier) + media + role are sourced; a maker envelope with labelled axes is still wanted.
